name: Stan Getz and Luiz Bonfá
hook: An American tenor saxophonist and a Brazilian guitarist's one joint bossa nova session, dug up three decades later for a Pharcyde hit.
blurb: The American saxophonist Stan Getz and the Brazilian guitarist Luiz Bonfá, key figures in bringing bossa nova to American jazz audiences, recorded the album 'Jazz Samba Encore!' together in New York in 1963. Its track 'Saudade Vem Correndo' was sampled by J Dilla for The Pharcyde's 'Runnin'' (1995), one of his first productions to reach an audience outside Detroit. They are on this map for that one joint record rather than their much larger separate careers, on the same basis as Bob James and Ahmad Jamal (Q21): jazz is a roots lane here, so its figures appear only where a documented sample connects them to an artist already on the map.

signatureTracks.title: Saudade Vem Correndo
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: From 'Jazz Samba Encore!' (Verve); its guitar and flute figure is the source for The Pharcyde's 'Runnin''.

signatureTracks.title: Só Danço Samba
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: An Antônio Carlos Jobim song from the same album, Jazz Samba Encore!, which mixes Jobim standards with Bonfá's own compositions.
